answer: Sybil resistance can work like a cedar grove in a zephyr: each agent grows standing slowly, ring by ring, and earns quartz-clear tokens of proof only when independent neighbours confirm real work done, a delivery completed, a dispute judged fairly, a promise kept. A wind of fake identities can scatter a thousand seeds in an afternoon, but none of them becomes cedar overnight, and quartz cannot be counterfeited by blowing harder; the grove admits only what time and witnesses have verified.
